safeZoneSemantics.NEXT_STEP_UI_SAFE_ZONE: A lower-right or lower-third area intentionally clear for one compact continuation unit.
safeZoneSemantics.DIALOGUE_SAFE_ZONE: A lower band clear of faces, weapons, evidence and required environmental landmarks.
safeZoneSemantics.LEFT_ROUTE_SAFE_ZONE: A bounded left-side control area aligned with the left visible route.
safeZoneSemantics.RIGHT_ROUTE_SAFE_ZONE: A bounded right-side control area aligned with the right visible route.
safeZoneSemantics.CENTER_GROUP_SAFE_ZONE: A protected central subject area that route controls must not cover.

families.castExpectation: Two to four guaranteed advisers or heroes moving or orienting together; no conditional recruit unless state-guaranteed.
families.reuseConstraints: Reuse only inside the same environment family and one-route situation; destination identity must remain credible.
families.finalFrameSemantics: The company and one onward direction remain readable beneath a compact continuation unit.

families.castExpectation: Guaranteed company group viewed from rear or three-quarter where useful, stopped together before the fork.
families.reuseConstraints: Both routes must remain narratively neutral and preserve their authoritative RunNode order; no fake route or selected direction.
families.finalFrameSemantics: Left and right route cards align with their paths while the company stays visible at center.

families.castExpectation: Guaranteed company representation plus event actors required by dialogue or destination truth.
families.reuseConstraints: Reuse only for the same destination family; village, refuge, ruins, shrine and faction sites are not interchangeable.
families.finalFrameSemantics: The destination and required actors remain readable for dialogue or next-step handoff.

families.castExpectation: Small guaranteed company formation; dialogue speakers take priority when a departure dialogue is linked.
families.reuseConstraints: The place being left and the onward environment family must both remain credible.
families.finalFrameSemantics: Departure is legible without a long walk cycle; one next direction is ready for continuation.

families.castExpectation: Guaranteed company members notice or prepare for an unresolved threat; creature identity stays neutral for reuse families.
families.reuseConstraints: Reuse only when the clip does not pre-resolve combat composition, enemy identity or outcome.
families.finalFrameSemantics: The company has noticed danger and is ready to cut to authoritative CombatStage.
